case_name: Magtajas v. Pryce Properties Corp. and PAGCOR
ordinance_no: Cagayan de Oro Ord. No. 3353 & Ord. No. 3375-93
title: AN ORDINANCE PROHIBITING THE OPERATION OF CASINOS IN THE CITY OF CAGAYAN DE ORO
enacting_clause: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF CAGAYAN DE ORO, IN SESSION ASSEMBLED, THAT:

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be known as the 'Anti-Casino Ordinance of the City of Cagayan de Oro'.
It is hereby declared the policy of the City to protect the morality and public welfare of its citizens from the pernicious influences of legalized gambling.
The opening, establishment, and operation of casinos and all forms of gambling are strictly prohibited and banned within the territorial jurisdiction of the City of Cagayan de Oro.
Any person or corporate entity operating a casino shall be punished by a fine of Five Thousand Pesos (P5,000.00) and imprisonment of one (1) year, plus immediate closure.
If any provision is declared invalid, the remainder shall continue in effect.
All resolutions and ordinances inconsistent with this enactment are repealed.
This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
